scenes.title: A New Life for Three
scenes.summary: Nastya moved in with Max and Kostya, but the guys still spend their time playing video games on the couch.

scenes.title: An Extra Roommate
scenes.summary: Max enters the bedroom inviting Kostya and Nastya to the cinema, driving Nastya to her limit.

scenes.title: A Morning Call
scenes.summary: Viktor Petrovich wakes up with a terrible headache as Lyuba calls to remind him about work.

scenes.title: Mom's Pancakes
scenes.summary: Lyova tries to wake Viktor Petrovich up with freshly made pancakes and reminders about work.

scenes.title: Morning Preparations
scenes.summary: Nastya complains about Max's morning routine.

scenes.title: A Difficult Conversation
scenes.summary: Kostya explains why he can't move in with Nastya.

scenes.title: Favor for a Favor
scenes.summary: Viktor makes a deal with Lyova.

scenes.title: Moving Out
scenes.summary: Max talks about moving out.

scenes.title: Without Max
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, the cooks are enjoying a rare moment of peace and quiet. Senya notes how great the atmosphere is today, and Fedya quickly points out the reason.

scenes.title: High Blood Pressure
scenes.summary: Leva measures Chef Victor's blood pressure and finds it dangerously high. He warns Victor about the risks. Meanwhile, Leva also talks to his mother on the phone about his stressful demotion.

scenes.title: Miraculous Healing
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, Leva manages the final orders of the night. Suddenly, Chef Victor reveals that his heart condition was completely faked just to force Leva back to work. Furious, Leva attacks him.

scenes.title: Evicting the Chef
scenes.summary: Still furious about the deception, Leva confronts Chef Victor through a closed door. He firmly demands that Victor pack his bags and move out of his and his mother's apartment immediately.

scenes.title: A Difficult Conversation
scenes.summary: Lyova and Max discuss the situation with Viktor Petrovich living at Lyova's place.

scenes.title: Apologies
scenes.summary: Lyova returns home and sincerely apologizes to a sleeping Viktor Petrovich.

scenes.title: A Second Heart Attack
scenes.summary: Viktor Petrovich reveals he heard Lyova's entire emotional speech.

scenes.title: A Bad Heart
scenes.summary: The chefs argue in the kitchen about who is really suffering from stress.

scenes.title: Desire to Move In
scenes.summary: Max arrives at Victoria's apartment and awkwardly asks to move in with her. He tries to sound independent, but eventually admits his true feelings.

scenes.title: Sleeping in the Hallway
scenes.summary: Victoria tells Max they should wait before living together, leaving him alone in the hallway. Soon after, Kostya calls Max to ask him to return to their apartment.

scenes.title: The Chef's Omelet
scenes.summary: In the morning, Chef Victor cooks breakfast for Leva and his mother. Leva wonders if this is Victor's way of apologizing for his earlier deception.

scenes.title: Waiting for Max
scenes.summary: Back at the restaurant, the staff is waiting to see if Max will finally return to work after everything that happened. They discuss his possible arrival.
